equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is reported; results are counts and percentages by month and co-occurring substance only.

notes: No design is named; surveillance/descriptive with trend is inferred from the medical examiner death series. The national <2% figure is cited from earlier reports, not the article's own result. Postmortem toxicology defines case status and is not a procedure.
view_issues: The article was corrected after publication (erratum 2022-05-06). Monthly values are only in the figure, which has no data in the packet; 'xylazine-associated' and 'xylazine-involved' are used interchangeably.
